river.bounce1: Diffuse low-sample grain is visible, but isolated bright white outliers are largely absent.
river.bounce2: Dense isolated bright white speckles appear across water, boat, embankment and building facades.
river.bounce3: Closely resembles bounce2 in outlier density and placement; little additional change.

ledge.bounce1: Fine grain but essentially no isolated bright white outliers; city remains visible through glass floor.
ledge.bounce2: Bright isolated outliers appear over city, transmitted glass floor view, and black sill reflections.

conclusion: The conspicuous bright outliers originate after enabling the second path bounce, consistent with high-variance indirect/glossy secondary contributions. Single-bounce is not noise-free but lacks the bright fireflies seen in multi-bounce images.
